items.title: Dolly Douroux Adams Interview, 1962-04-18
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] I heard he play, too. He made some records with the Bunk Johnson, the trumpet, the famous trumpet player who he knew quite well.

ctx.x: But he was popular at the time that I was popular.
I heard he play, too. He made some records with the Bunk Johnson, the trumpet, the famous trumpet player who he knew quite well. He's dead now, too. Any other pianists that you heard?
I guess I heard a gang of them,
